extracted.name: Simple Maple Syrup
extracted.description: This homemade maple syrup recipe comes together with three pantry staples and delivers a rich, sweet topping for pancakes, waffles, French toast, and more.
instruction_lines: Combine sugar and water in a saucepan. Cook and stir until sugar is dissolved. Remove from heat, and stir in maple flavoring. Serve warm.
